description: The figure is a pie chart intended to represent four categories related to an “NP problem challenge” benchmark, shown as a circle divided into 4 slices of equal size (approximately 25% each). The top-left slice is labeled “Complexity” and is colored orange/yellow; the top-right slice is labeled “Instance” and is colored light blue; the bottom-right slice is labeled “Coverage” and is colored light green; and the bottom-left slice is labeled “Scalable Oversight” and is colored red/pink. Each slice contains a small icon, and there are no numeric percentage labels displayed inside the slices. Around the pie, there are additional boxed words aligned with the corresponding quadrants—“Uncrushable” near the Complexity quadrant, “Unhackable” near Instance, “General” near Coverage, and “Auto-verifiable” near Scalable Oversight—serving as callouts rather than a separate legend; no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized beyond the quadrant layout.
